title: Teddy's Little Big Adventure
author: Claude
blurb: Gwin ran off with Doc Leo's clown costume, and tonight is the Klown Klub's Big Show. Hop, bark, dig, high five, sit, spin, roll over and play dead across town as Teddy, a little corgi with a ton of tricks.

box.tagline: A little dog. A big town. A ton of tricks.
box.back:
Teddy is a Pembroke Welsh Corgi. He is short, he is fluffy, and he knows a ton of tricks. His person, Doc Leo, is a friendly hobo clown and the star of tonight's Big Show at the Klown Klub - but Teddy's big sister Gwin just galloped off with Doc Leo's costume suitcase and scattered it all over town.

No nose, no show! Dig under the back fence, high five the bow tie off the yard-sale balloons, sit pretty for the kids in the park, spin through the revolving doors downtown and play dead under the flying pies, then win over the whole Klown Klub with every trick in the book. Every trick opens a way forward.
features: Nine tricks on nine keys: hop, speak, dig, fetch, high five, sit pretty, spin, roll over and play dead
Five levels from Doc Leo's backyard to the Big Top, morning to showtime
Fountains, steam vents and trampolines that launch you skyward
Revolving doors, sprinklers, frisbees, geese and a custard-pie barrage
Doc Leo and his kind, funny Klown Klub friends
Gwin, who ruins everything (and learns one trick)
Ten original Sound Blaster FM songs and digitized woofs
